Subject: Redwood - procurement & security next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for your time today. Great conversation with you and Priya on the procurement timeline and Daniel on security gating. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Procurement path: Acme prefers PO-based commitments for reserved capacity, card for initial pilot. Priya mentioned a 60–90 day internal approval window for POs.
- Security gating: Daniel requested SOC 2 attestation, our standard DPA, and answers to a 40‑question security questionnaire.
- Commercials: We discussed committed capacity vs metered hosted API; you wanted a sample cost estimate for a 6‑month pilot.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll attach the SOC 2 attestation and our current DPA draft for your legal/security review.
2) Stephanie will follow up with a short commercial estimate and a checklist of procurement docs (PO wording, billing contact, SOW if needed).
3) If helpful, we can put together a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone dates to map to your 60–90 day window.

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf, Redwood_DPA_v3.docx

Anything I missed or incorrect? If that's right, I’ll send the MAP and the security questionnaire responses early next week.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa — thanks for the notes and attachments. A few clarifications from procurement side: 

- PO vs Card: We want to run a 30–45 day pilot on card (internal policy allows card for <$25k pilots). After pilot, procurement will issue a PO for committed capacity.
- Billing/legal: Our billing contact is Jordan (cc’d). Legal will want to review the DPA; please send editable Word/track-changes copy.
- Marketplace: There’s internal interest in evaluating Redwood via the AWS Marketplace (would simplify purchasing). Are you listed there or is that a roadmap item?

Can you and Stephanie confirm: what’s the billing cadence for a PO (monthly in advance, net 30)? Also please include any procurement wording we should include in the PO (e.g., invoice remit and portal).

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the internal PO timeline once we have a sample SOW/estimate.

Best,
Priya Sharma
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
priya.sharma@acme.com

Subject: Re: Redwood - procurement & security next steps

Folks — quick security ask: can you confirm the following before we move to PO?

1) SOC 2 scope: Is the attestation unqualified and does it cover the Redwood inference hosting for production (i.e., multi-tenant hosted API)?
2) DPA: we need to see standard security annex and subprocessors list.
3) Questionnaire: I’ll send our security questionnaire (approx 40 Qs). Please indicate if you can return a completed spreadsheet within 10 business days.

If any of these require legal or privacy escalation at Redwood, please flag. We’d prefer not to block the PO, but we need written confirmation on these items before procurement will approve.

Thanks,
Daniel Price
Director, Information Security — Acme Corp

Hi Priya / Jordan —

Thanks for the clarifications. A few concrete answers and attachments to keep things moving: 

- Billing cadence for PO: We bill monthly in arrears by default, but for PO-based committed capacity we can support monthly in advance or net 30 invoicing on request. Please let me know which you prefer and we’ll reflect it in the MAP.
- PO language: Suggested invoice remit and sample wording attached (see "PO_Sample_Wording.txt").
- Marketplace: Redwood is currently listed in the AWS Marketplace for metered offerings; reserved capacity via marketplace is a roadmap item (ETA: Q3 2027). If marketplace purchasing is a hard requirement for procurement, let us know and we can raise it with product/partnerships.
- SOC 2 / DPA: Marissa attached the attestation and DPA. The SOC 2 report is unqualified and covers our hosted inference production environment (see SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf). The DPA we attached includes the security annex; subprocessors list is included in the addendum.
- Questionnaire: We can return a completed spreadsheet within 7 business days from receipt; please send the questionnaire to security-requests@redwood.ai. Alternatively, if Daniel prefers, we can schedule a 30-minute call to walk through any high-risk items.

Attachments included in this email: PO_Sample_Wording.txt, Security_Questionnaire_Response.xlsx (initial answers stub)

Next steps:
1) Priya / Jordan — confirm preferred billing cadence (monthly in advance vs net 30).
2) Daniel — send questionnaire to security-requests@redwood.ai and we’ll commit to a 7 business day turnaround for the spreadsheet.
3) Marissa / Vivek — we’ll draft a MAP once billing cadence confirmed.

Happy to hop on a quick call later this week if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
